findings.title: SPF record
findings.description: SPF record is present and uses an enforcing policy.
findings.remediation: No action needed. Review SPF includes annually as you change email providers.

findings.title: DMARC policy
findings.description: DMARC is in monitor-only mode (p=none). Spoofed messages are not being blocked.
findings.remediation: Review DMARC aggregate reports for several weeks, fix any legitimate sources failing alignment, then move to p=quarantine and eventually p=reject.

findings.title: TLS certificate
findings.description: Valid certificate issued by Let's Encrypt, expires in 47 days. Protocol: TLSv1.3.
findings.remediation: No action needed. Confirm renewal automation is in place.

findings.title: Header: strict-transport-security
findings.description: HSTS forces browsers to use HTTPS for future visits. Without it, a downgrade attack on the first request is possible.

findings.title: Port 3389 (RDP) exposed
findings.description: Port 3389 (RDP) is reachable from the public internet. Remote Desktop - never expose to the internet.
findings.remediation: Block RDP at the firewall. Require VPN or a Zero Trust gateway for remote access.
